verdict.rationale: Notion documents its own connections that sync data from other tools into the workspace, including a GitHub sync integration, and positions itself as 'one system of record'. That suggests external work items can be brought into Notion views. However, nothing shows assigned tasks from multiple project management tools (e.g., Jira, Linear, Asana) being aggregated into one unified per-user view; the REST API and MCP are only building blocks. missing for 10: documented sync with multiple PM tools beyond GitHub, an assigned-to-me unified task view across those sources, hands-on corroboration.
